result.topic_en: This page gives the analysis behind reducing the form 2x^4 - y^4 = z^2. It then proves that a solution of ma^4 - nb^4 = c^2 yields a solution of x^4 - mny^4 = z^2, and finds rational p, q, r, s for which pq(pp-qq)/rs(rr-ss) is a square.
result.transcription:
222 L. EULERI OPERA POSTHUMA. Arithmetica.

Analysis, qua haec reductio est inventa. Posito $2x^4-y^4=zz$, debet esse
$xx=pp+qq,\quad yy=pp+2pq-qq,$ tum enim fiet $z=qq+2pq-pp$.
Hic ergo $p$ et $q$ ita definiri debent, ut $xx$ et $yy$ fiant quadrata, quod sequenti modo praestari potest: Cum sit $yy-xx=2q(p-q)=(y+x)(y-x)$, jam statuatur $y+x=\frac{2a}{b}.q$ et $y-x=\frac{b}{a}(p-q)$. Sic enim fiet $yy-xx=2q(p-q)$. Addantur jam quadrata, fiet
$2yy+2xx=\frac{4aa}{bb}qq+\frac{bb}{aa}pp-\frac{2bb}{aa}pq+\frac{bb}{aa}qq.$
At vero ex primis formulis fiet $2yy+2xx=4pp+4pq$, qui valor illi aequatus et multiplicatione facta per $aabb$ dat
$(b^4-4aabb)pp-2pq(b^4+2aabb)+(b^4+4a^4)qq=0.$
Hinc radicem extrahendo fit $\frac{p}{q}=\ldots\ldots$

Theorema. Si fuerit $ma^4-nb^4=cc$, inde assignari potest talis forma $x^4-mny^4=zz$.

Demonstratio. Posito enim $ma^4+nb^4=\Delta$, erit $\Delta\Delta=c^4+4mna^4b^4$. At in altera formula si ponatur $xx=pp+mnqq$ et $yy=2pq$, fiet $z=pp-mnqq$. Jam statuatur $p=rr$ et $q=2ss$, ut fiat $y=2rs$, hinc fiet $xx=r^4+4mns^4$. Facta ergo comparatione erit $x=\Delta$, $r=c$, $s=ab$, unde fit $y=2abc$, $z=c^4-4mna^4b^4$. Hinc ergo necesse est ut fiat
$x^4-mny^4=zz.$
A. m. T. III. p. 129. 131.

58.

Observatio. Ut formula $\frac{pq(pp-qq)}{rs(rr-ss)}$ fiat quadratum, sumatur
$p=aa+bb\qquad r=aa+bb$
$q=2aa-bb\qquad s=2bb-aa$
hinc $p+q=3aa\qquad r+s=3bb$
$p-q=2bb-aa\qquad r-s=2aa-bb$
substituendo fit formula $\frac{pq(pp-qq)}{rs(rr-ss)}=\frac{aa}{bb}$.
Aliter, sumi etiam potest
$p=bb-2aa\qquad r=2bb-4aa$
$q=6aa\qquad s=bb+4aa$
hinc $p+q=bb+4aa\qquad r+s=3bb$
$p-q=bb-8aa\qquad r-s=bb-8aa$
ac substituendo: $\frac{pq(pp-qq)}{rs(rr-ss)}=\frac{aa}{bb}$.
Ita sumi potest $p=7$, $q=6$, $r=14$ et $s=13$, eritque $pq(pp-qq)=546$, $rs(rr-ss)=4914$
hinc formula $=\frac{546}{4914}=\frac{1}{9}=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2$.
A. m. T. I. p. 295.

59.

Evolutio generalior formulae: $\frac{pq(pp-qq)}{rs(rr-ss)}=\square=n$.
Hic ponatur $q=\alpha t$ et $s=\beta t$, tum vero $p=\nu r$, unde reperitur
